paragraphs.text: Suppose an initial estimate misses the measured charge by five microcoulombs, while a refined model reduces the error to three.
paragraphs.translation: 假设最初估计与实测电荷相差五微库仑，而改进模型把误差减至三微库仑。

paragraphs.text: The diminution of two microcoulombs describes the amount removed from the error, not the new error of three microcoulombs.
paragraphs.translation: 两微库仑的减少量，指从误差中减掉的数量，而不是三微库仑这一新的误差值。

title: Ninety Words Left to a Sister

paragraphs.text: On 27 April 1817, Jane Austen wrote a short will on a small sheet of paper.
paragraphs.translation: 1817年4月27日，Jane Austen在一小张纸上写下简短遗嘱。

paragraphs.text: She left most of what she possessed, and what might later be due to her, to her sister Cassandra.
paragraphs.translation: 她把大部分已有财物以及以后可能应得之物，都留给了姐姐Cassandra。

paragraphs.text: Two legacies of fifty pounds each went to her brother Henry and to Madame Bigeon.
paragraphs.translation: 另有两笔各五十英镑的遗赠，分别留给哥哥Henry与Madame Bigeon。

paragraphs.text: The document at The National Archives makes a family relationship visible through a practical act of inheritance.
paragraphs.translation: 英国国家档案馆的这份文件，通过一次实际继承安排，让家庭关系可见。

paragraphs.text: Cassandra would inherit personal possessions and money, while also serving as the person appointed to carry out the will.
paragraphs.translation: Cassandra将继承私人物品与金钱，同时担任被指定执行遗嘱的人。

paragraphs.text: An inheritor receives property; an executor carries responsibilities, and one person can occupy both positions.
paragraphs.translation: 继承人接受财物；遗嘱执行人承担责任，而同一个人可以处于两种位置。

paragraphs.text: Austen folded the sheet and wrote a brief identification on its reverse.
paragraphs.translation: Austen折起纸张，在背面写下简短识别文字。

paragraphs.text: The will named Cassandra as executrix, the feminine form used in the document for the person who would administer it.
paragraphs.translation: 遗嘱把Cassandra列为executrix，即文件中用于遗嘱执行人的女性形式。

paragraphs.text: Cassandra appears here as an inheritrix as well, a female recipient of what her sister left.
paragraphs.translation: Cassandra在这里也作为女性继承人出现，接收妹妹留下的财物。

paragraphs.text: The arrangement treated her as inheritable, capable of receiving the property designated for her.
paragraphs.translation: 这一安排把她视为具备继承资格的人，能够接收指定给她的财物。

paragraphs.text: Her inheritance was therefore both a material provision and an expression of trust.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，她得到的遗产既是物质安排，也是信任的表达。

paragraphs.text: The future value of Austen's writing matters to the wording of the will.
paragraphs.translation: Austen作品的未来价值，对遗嘱措辞具有意义。

paragraphs.text: It included what might later become due, so the paper looked beyond the money already present.
paragraphs.translation: 遗嘱包括将来可能应得之物，因此，这张纸着眼于当时已有金钱之外。

paragraphs.text: Rights that are inheritable can continue to produce consequences after the person who created the work has died.
paragraphs.translation: 能够继承的权利，在作品创造者去世后仍能继续产生后果。

paragraphs.text: Their inheritability connects a legal arrangement with the continuing life of a work.
paragraphs.translation: 权利的可继承性，把法律安排与作品持续的生命联系起来。

paragraphs.text: The archival account records later money received when Northanger Abbey and Persuasion were published.
paragraphs.translation: 档案说明记录了《诺桑觉寺》与《劝导》出版后，后来收到的款项。

paragraphs.text: The will was unwitnessed, a feature that made its handwriting particularly important in the subsequent proceedings.
paragraphs.translation: 遗嘱没有见证签名，这使其笔迹在后来的程序中尤其重要。

paragraphs.text: Family friends gave evidence that they recognised Austen's handwriting and signature.
paragraphs.translation: 家族朋友作证，表示认得Austen的笔迹与签名。

paragraphs.text: Their evidence sustained the claim that the document was hers.
paragraphs.translation: 他们的证言支持并证实了文件出自她手的主张。

paragraphs.text: The will was proved in September 1817, giving Cassandra authority to act.
paragraphs.translation: 遗嘱于1817年9月得到认证，赋予Cassandra执行权。

paragraphs.text: In her capacity as executrix, she held an office distinct from the affection that linked the sisters.
paragraphs.translation: 以遗嘱执行人的身份，她承担着一种职务，这与姐妹之间的感情是不同层面的关系。

paragraphs.text: The will's concise language, folded surface and later annotations record how private intention entered an institutional world.
paragraphs.translation: 遗嘱简洁的措辞、折叠的纸面和后来的批注，记录了私人意愿如何进入制度世界。

paragraphs.text: A retainable piece of evidence can acquire new value when later readers ask different questions of it.
paragraphs.translation: 一份能够保留的证据，可以在后人提出不同问题时获得新价值。

paragraphs.text: The retainability of old paper depends partly on its physical condition and the means available to preserve it.
paragraphs.translation: 旧纸的可保留性，部分取决于其物理状态以及可用的保存手段。

paragraphs.text: Its retainment allows the words to remain available even as the people and institutions around them change.
paragraphs.translation: 将它保留下来，使这些文字在周围人物与机构改变后仍可接触。

paragraphs.text: Some benefits of survival are intangible: a reader can sense a relationship without reducing it to an amount of money.
paragraphs.translation: 幸存带来的一些价值难以量化：读者能够感到一种关系，而不把它缩减为金钱数额。

paragraphs.text: Those intangibles accompany the tangibles of paper, ink and the property the will once governed.
paragraphs.translation: 这些难以量化的价值，伴随着纸、墨与遗嘱曾经支配的财产等有形之物。

title: A Home Has a Price, a Title and a Balance Sheet

paragraphs.text: A home is a habitat for people, but buying one also involves a transfer of legal rights.
paragraphs.translation: 住宅是人们的居所，但购买住宅还涉及法律权利的转移。

paragraphs.text: To convey the property is to transfer ownership, rather than physically carry the building somewhere else.
paragraphs.translation: 转让房产，是转移所有权，而非把建筑搬到别处。

paragraphs.text: The conveyance is the legal transaction, and a conveyance can also name the document that gives effect to it.
paragraphs.translation: 产权转移是法律交易，而conveyance也可以指使这种转移生效的文书。

paragraphs.text: A conveyancer handles the work of identifying the property, examining rights and completing the transfer.
paragraphs.translation: 产权转让事务经办人，负责识别房产、审查权利并完成转让。

paragraphs.text: Conveyancing consequently connects written descriptions with the actual place a buyer expects to occupy.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，产权转让业务把书面描述与买家预期居住的实际场所连接起来。

paragraphs.text: What is conveyable depends on the rights held and the legal restrictions attached to them.
paragraphs.translation: 什么能够被转让，取决于所持权利及其法律限制。

paragraphs.text: The UK government's home-buying guide describes a contract containing the price, boundaries, included fittings, restrictions and proposed completion.
paragraphs.translation: 英国政府的购房指南介绍了载明价格、边界、所含装置、限制与拟定完成安排的合同。

paragraphs.text: Buyer and seller may compromise on details before they exchange final contracts.
paragraphs.translation: 买卖双方可以在交换最终合同前，就细节相互让步。

paragraphs.text: A compromiser looks for terms that can be accepted by both sides while keeping the agreement clear.
paragraphs.translation: 寻求折中的人，会寻找双方都能接受、同时保持协议清楚的条款。

paragraphs.text: In the process described by the guide, exchanging contracts makes the agreement legally binding.
paragraphs.translation: 在该指南描述的程序中，交换合同使协议具有法律约束力。

paragraphs.text: Completion then brings the transfer of money, documents, possession and keys into their agreed relationship.
paragraphs.translation: 随后，交易完成把资金、文书、占有与钥匙的移交，带入约定关系。

paragraphs.text: The home's financial position involves another quantity: equity.
paragraphs.translation: 住宅的财务状况还涉及另一个量：净权益。

paragraphs.text: For this purpose, equity is the current property value minus the outstanding mortgage balance.
paragraphs.translation: 在这里，净权益等于房产当前价值减去未还按揭余额。

paragraphs.text: A fall in value can reduce equity even while the owner continues to make regular payments.
paragraphs.translation: 即使房主继续定期还款，价值下跌仍能减少净权益。

paragraphs.text: Negative equity occurs when the mortgage balance exceeds the property's value.
paragraphs.translation: 按揭余额超过房产价值时，就出现负权益。

paragraphs.text: In a hypothetical example, a home worth two hundred thousand pounds with a two-hundred-and-twenty-thousand-pound mortgage has negative equity of twenty thousand pounds.
paragraphs.translation: 在一个假设例子中，价值二十万英镑的住宅，若有二十二万英镑未还按揭，就有两万英镑负权益。

paragraphs.text: MoneyHelper explains that a shortfall can make a move more difficult because selling the asset may not repay the whole debt.
paragraphs.translation: MoneyHelper解释，缺口可能使搬家更困难，因为出售资产未必能偿还全部债务。

paragraphs.text: A household unable to cover the shortfall may feel it has no alternative but to postpone the move.
paragraphs.translation: 无力补足缺口的家庭，可能觉得自己别无选择，只能推迟搬家。

paragraphs.text: Two proposed uses of the same money may be alternative in the strict sense that choosing one rules out the other.
paragraphs.translation: 对同一笔钱提出的两种用途，可以在严格意义上互为择一方案：选择一种，就排除另一种。

paragraphs.text: An alternate plan may change the timing or structure of a move without changing the underlying ownership problem.
paragraphs.translation: 一项备选计划，可以改变搬家的时间或结构，而不改变背后的所有权问题。

paragraphs.text: A buyer may also inherit a predecessor's maintenance problems, even after the paperwork is complete.
paragraphs.translation: 即使书面手续已经完成，买方还可能接手前任房主遗留的维护问题。

paragraphs.text: That inheritance of neglected repairs belongs to the property's recent history as well as to its present financial situation.
paragraphs.translation: 这份失修问题的遗留，既属于房产近期的历史，也属于它当前的财务处境。

title: Robert Peel and the Cost of Changing a Policy

paragraphs.text: In 1689, a Convention of Lords and MPs met without having been summoned by the king.
paragraphs.translation: 1689年，贵族与议员在未经国王召集的情况下组成非常议会。

paragraphs.text: The convention of that assembly was itself part of the effort to establish an acceptable political settlement.
paragraphs.translation: 召集这一会议的行动本身，就是建立可接受政治安排的努力的一部分。

paragraphs.text: The intervening years brought further adjustments, rather than one moment settling the whole constitutional relationship.
paragraphs.translation: 其间岁月带来了进一步调整，而非某一时刻就决定全部宪制关系。

paragraphs.text: Robert Peel's career presents a later example within a Conservative government.
paragraphs.translation: Robert Peel的生涯，提供了保守党政府内部的一个较晚例子。

paragraphs.text: Peel was a Conservative who held office in the 1830s and again in the 1840s.
paragraphs.translation: Peel是一位保守党成员，曾在十九世纪三十年代与四十年代执政。

paragraphs.text: The government's historical account describes reforms to criminal law, policing and factory work during his career.
paragraphs.translation: 政府的历史介绍，描述了他任内对刑法、警务与工厂劳动的改革。

paragraphs.text: His experience illustrates a tension within conservatism: an institution may be preserved partly by accepting changes to how it operates.
paragraphs.translation: 他的经历说明保守主义内部的一种张力：接受制度运行方式的改变，可能恰恰有助于保存制度。

paragraphs.text: A conservative can therefore face a choice between defending an existing policy and maintaining a wider political order.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，一位保守派人士可能面临选择：维护既有政策，还是维持更广泛的政治秩序。

paragraphs.text: The conservativeness of an institution does not determine every decision made by the people within it.
paragraphs.translation: 制度的保守性，并不能决定其中每个人的每项决策。

paragraphs.text: Peel initially opposed Catholic emancipation, then helped carry it through Parliament after becoming persuaded of the danger of civil conflict.
paragraphs.translation: Peel起初反对天主教解放，后来因相信内乱危险而帮助推动其在议会通过。

paragraphs.text: His reversal shocked supporters who had relied on his earlier position.
paragraphs.translation: 他的立场逆转，使依赖其早先立场的支持者震惊。

paragraphs.text: An uncompromising supporter of the earlier position could regard the change as betrayal.
paragraphs.translation: 坚定不肯让步的原立场支持者，可以把这种改变视为背叛。

paragraphs.text: Uncompromisingness gives a position consistency, but also makes a response to new circumstances harder.
paragraphs.translation: 不愿妥协使立场一致，却也使对新环境作出回应更难。

paragraphs.text: An intervenient crisis can alter the consequences of leaving an old rule in place.
paragraphs.translation: 介入其间的危机，可以改变保留旧规则所带来的后果。

paragraphs.text: In the 1840s, the Corn Laws placed barriers on imported grain.
paragraphs.translation: 十九世纪四十年代，《谷物法》对进口谷物设置壁垒。

paragraphs.text: Harvest failure and the Irish famine brought the consequences of food policy into especially urgent focus.
paragraphs.translation: 歉收与爱尔兰饥荒，使粮食政策的后果变得格外迫切。

paragraphs.text: Peel eventually decided that the laws had to be repealed, while landowners resisted and his party divided.
paragraphs.translation: Peel最终认定必须废除这些法律，而地主抵制、其政党分裂。

paragraphs.text: The policy shift changed the terms of political loyalty as well as the rules of trade.
paragraphs.translation: 这次政策转变，既改变了政治忠诚的条件，也改变了贸易规则。

paragraphs.text: To shift a position under those conditions meant accepting consequences for the government itself.
paragraphs.translation: 在那些条件下改变立场，意味着接受政府本身也要承受后果。

paragraphs.text: The repeal passed in June 1846, but Peel was defeated on another bill and resigned.
paragraphs.translation: 废除法案于1846年6月通过，但Peel在另一法案上遭到否决，随后辞职。

paragraphs.text: A legislative success and a major political reverse therefore formed part of the same outcome.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，一项立法成功与一次重大政治挫败，构成了同一结果的不同部分。

paragraphs.text: The party sustained a division that outlasted the immediate vote.
paragraphs.translation: 政党遭受了延续到当次表决之后的分裂。

paragraphs.text: The story makes a simple description of conservative politics less simple.
paragraphs.translation: 这个故事，使对保守政治的简单描述变得不再简单。

paragraphs.text: A conservative approach can mean caution about the pace of change, while a party label identifies a particular organisation.
paragraphs.translation: 保守做法可以意味着谨慎对待变革速度，而政党标签指认的是特定组织。

paragraphs.text: A proposal conservative in tone may avoid extremes even when it changes an established practice.
paragraphs.translation: 基调温和的提议，即使改变既有做法，也可以避免极端。

paragraphs.text: His government had inherited a difficult situation, and its response became part of the inheritance passed to later governments.
paragraphs.translation: 他的政府接手了困难局面，而其回应又成为留给后来政府的遗留处境的一部分。

paragraphs.text: The result belongs to the evolution of political practice, in which institutions persist while their purposes and policies are contested.
paragraphs.translation: 结果属于政治实践的逐步发展：制度持续存在，其目的与政策却不断受到争论。

title: A School Case and the Right to Be Heard

paragraphs.text: Brown v. Board of Education brought a constitutional question into the daily life of public schools.
paragraphs.translation: 《布朗诉教育委员会案》把一个宪法问题带入公立学校的日常生活。

paragraphs.text: Children had been denied access to schools attended by white children under laws permitting or requiring racial separation.
paragraphs.translation: 在允许或要求种族隔离的法律下，孩子们被拒绝进入白人孩子就读的学校。

paragraphs.text: Those laws discriminated on the basis of race, making racial identity a condition of educational access.
paragraphs.translation: 这些法律基于种族作区别对待，把种族身份变为获得教育的条件。

paragraphs.text: A discriminatory arrangement could be enforced through ordinary administrative decisions about admission.
paragraphs.translation: 歧视性安排，可以通过普通的入学行政决定来执行。

paragraphs.text: The resulting discrimination concerned participation in an institution central to public life.
paragraphs.translation: 由此产生的歧视，涉及对公共生活核心机构的参与。

paragraphs.text: In 1954, the Supreme Court unanimously held that state-imposed racial segregation in public schools violated equal protection.
paragraphs.translation: 1954年，最高法院一致裁定，公立学校中由州实施的种族隔离违反平等保护。

paragraphs.text: Equal-looking buildings and equipment did not settle what separation itself did to the opportunity to learn.
paragraphs.translation: 看起来相等的建筑与设备，并不能决定隔离本身对学习机会造成什么影响。

paragraphs.text: The Court considered intangible elements such as participation in discussion and the exchange of ideas.
paragraphs.translation: 法院考虑了参与讨论、交流思想等难以量化的要素。

paragraphs.text: Those intangibles belonged to the substance of education, rather than merely to its atmosphere.
paragraphs.translation: 这些难以量化的要素属于教育实质，而不只是气氛。

paragraphs.text: To integrate schools was to end an exclusion built into their admissions, allowing children of different races to participate together.
paragraphs.translation: 使学校取消种族隔离，就是结束嵌入招生制度的排斥，让不同种族的孩子共同参与。

paragraphs.text: An integrated school system would have to make that participation real in its operation.
paragraphs.translation: 取消隔离的学校系统，必须在实际运行中实现这种参与。

paragraphs.text: An integrationist supported that change, while the practical work of integration extended beyond the declaration of a legal principle.
paragraphs.translation: 主张取消隔离的人支持这种改变，而实际融合工作超出了宣布法律原则。

paragraphs.text: The 1954 opinion returned the cases for further argument about the form of the orders.
paragraphs.translation: 1954年的判决意见，将案件交回，以进一步论辩命令应采取什么形式。

paragraphs.text: In 1955, the Court reversed the judgments below except in the Delaware case, and sent the cases back for further proceedings.
paragraphs.translation: 1955年，最高法院撤销了特拉华案以外的下级判决，并把案件发回作进一步处理。

paragraphs.text: It affirmed the Delaware judgment ordering immediate admission, while also returning that case for further proceedings.
paragraphs.translation: 法院维持了特拉华案要求立即准许入学的判决，同时也将该案发回作后续处理。

paragraphs.text: The opinion directed courts to use equitable principles in shaping remedies and to retain jurisdiction during the transition.
paragraphs.translation: 判决要求法院依衡平原则制定救济措施，并在过渡期间保留管辖权。

paragraphs.text: In courtroom procedure more generally, a judge may sustain an objection to a question, preventing that question from proceeding in its challenged form.
paragraphs.translation: 在更一般的庭审程序中，法官可以认可针对某个问题的异议，使该问题不能以受到质疑的形式继续提出。

paragraphs.text: A ruling on a question and an appellate judgment act at different levels of the legal process.
paragraphs.translation: 针对一个问题作出的裁定，与上诉审判决，作用于法律程序的不同层次。

paragraphs.text: Legal representation made it possible for the children's claims to be presented through an established process.
paragraphs.translation: 法律代理使孩子们的主张能够通过既定程序提出。

paragraphs.text: An advocate for a child speaks for that person's rights and interests.
paragraphs.translation: 儿童权益代表为孩子的权利与利益发声。

paragraphs.text: An advocate appearing in court also occupies a professional role with obligations to the legal process.
paragraphs.translation: 出庭律师还承担着对法律程序负有义务的专业角色。

paragraphs.text: Professional advocateship is more than the ability to speak forcefully; it includes responsibility for how a case is presented.
paragraphs.translation: 专业律师身份不只是有力发言的能力，还包括对案件如何被陈述承担责任。

paragraphs.text: To advocate a client's position is to plead for it with reasons that the court can examine.
paragraphs.translation: 为当事人立场辩护，就是用法院能够审查的理由来申辩。

paragraphs.text: Advocacy in court connects a person's experience with questions of law, evidence and remedy.
paragraphs.translation: 法庭辩护把个人经历与法律、证据和救济问题连接起来。

paragraphs.text: An advocate for integrated education can also work outside court, publicly supporting a cause.
paragraphs.translation: 主张取消教育隔离的人，也能在法庭之外工作，公开支持一项事业。

paragraphs.text: An advocacy organisation seeks to influence institutions, while representation in a particular case gives a more specific responsibility.
paragraphs.translation: 倡议组织谋求影响制度，而特定案件中的代理赋予更具体的责任。

paragraphs.text: The wider rules of civil procedure show another way a person can seek a place in an existing dispute.
paragraphs.translation: 更广泛的民事程序规则，展示了一个人寻求在既有争议中取得位置的另一种方式。

paragraphs.text: Under federal Rule 24, a person may be permitted to intervene in proceedings under specified conditions.
paragraphs.translation: 根据联邦第24条规则，一个人可以在特定条件下获准参加已有诉讼。

paragraphs.text: Such an intervenor enters as a party seeking to protect an interest, rather than simply commenting from outside.
paragraphs.translation: 这样的诉讼参加人，是作为寻求保护利益的一方进入，而不只是从外部评论。

paragraphs.text: The rule distinguishes intervention as of right from permissive intervention and directs attention to adequate representation, delay and prejudice.
paragraphs.translation: 该规则区分当然参加诉讼与许可参加诉讼，并关注充分代理、拖延与不利影响。

paragraphs.text: The legal language of equity adds a further historical dimension: courts have used equitable principles and remedies alongside rules of common law.
paragraphs.translation: 衡平法的法律语言还增添一个历史维度：法院曾在普通法规则之外，使用衡平原则与救济。

paragraphs.text: Brown's continuing significance lies partly in that connection between a lived exclusion and a public account of equal protection.
paragraphs.translation: 《布朗案》的持续意义，部分就在于把生活中的排斥与平等保护的公共说明连接起来。

title: What a Share Owns and What a Yield Measures

paragraphs.text: A share gives its holder a stake in a company, rather than ownership of one particular machine in its factory.
paragraphs.translation: 股份使持有人拥有公司的一份权益，而非单独拥有工厂中的某台机器。

paragraphs.text: Equity represents that ownership interest, and issuing shares can provide a company with capital for its activities.
paragraphs.translation: 股本权益代表这种所有权利益，而发行股份能够为公司活动提供资本。

paragraphs.text: Equities are stocks, which investors may hold for income, changes in value or a combination of the two.
paragraphs.translation: 股票是股权投资，投资者可以为收入、价值变化或两者结合而持有它们。

paragraphs.text: The SEC's investor explanation describes dividends as distributions from a company's earnings.
paragraphs.translation: SEC的投资者说明，把股息描述为公司从盈利中作出的分配。

paragraphs.text: It also distinguishes types of shares and notes that growth-oriented companies may pay little or no dividend.
paragraphs.translation: 它还区分股票类型，并指出以增长为主的公司可能很少支付或不支付股息。

paragraphs.text: A company's capacity to produce goods and its capacity to distribute cash are therefore different aspects of its business.
paragraphs.translation: 公司的商品产能与分配现金的能力，因此是其业务的不同方面。

paragraphs.text: An investment can yield income without its market price rising.
paragraphs.translation: 投资可以产生收入，而其市价未必上涨。

paragraphs.text: Yield expresses the income or return in relation to the investment, so the stated basis of calculation matters.
paragraphs.translation: 投资收益或收益率，把收入或回报与投资联系起来，因此，明示的计算基础很重要。

paragraphs.text: In a simple hypothetical calculation, fifty pounds of annual income on a one-thousand-pound purchase gives an income yield of five per cent before costs.
paragraphs.translation: 在一个简单假设计算中，一千英镑买入的投资，每年产生五十英镑收入，成本前的收入收益率为百分之五。

paragraphs.text: A bond may be a modest yielder because its regular payments are small in relation to the amount invested.
paragraphs.translation: 一只债券可能属于收益不高的资产，因为其定期付款相对于投资金额较小。

paragraphs.text: In that hypothetical budget, income could be estimated conservatively at forty pounds rather than the expected fifty.
paragraphs.translation: 在这个假设预算中，可以把收入保守估计为四十英镑，低于预期的五十英镑。

paragraphs.text: A claim that every share must produce a dividend is unsustainable in the face of the different company policies described by the SEC.
paragraphs.translation: 面对SEC介绍的不同公司政策，声称每只股票都必定派息的主张无法成立。

paragraphs.text: A fund offers a medium through which money from several investors can be invested together.
paragraphs.translation: 基金提供了一个途径，使多位投资者的资金能够共同投资。

paragraphs.text: An allocator of that capital determines how it is distributed among the investments permitted by the fund's approach.
paragraphs.translation: 这些资本的分配者，决定资金怎样分布在基金方法允许的投资之中。

paragraphs.text: To diversify is to spread investment across different holdings instead of making the whole outcome depend on one company.
paragraphs.translation: 分散投资，就是把投资分布到不同持仓，而不让全部结果依赖一家公司。

paragraphs.text: Different holdings can behave diversely as business conditions change.
paragraphs.translation: 商业条件变化时，不同持仓可以以不同方式表现。

paragraphs.text: A series of reversals in one business can then have a different effect from the failure of the only business held.
paragraphs.translation: 一项业务的一系列经济挫折，便可能产生不同于唯一持有业务失败的影响。

paragraphs.text: Diversification changes the distribution of exposure; it does not turn ownership into a fixed promise of income.
paragraphs.translation: 分散投资改变风险敞口的分布；它不会把所有权变成固定收入承诺。

paragraphs.text: A mutual building society offers a different relationship between an institution and its owners.
paragraphs.translation: 成员制建房互助会，为机构与所有者提供了另一种关系。

paragraphs.text: The Building Societies Association describes institutions owned by members who are borrowers and savers, rather than by a separate body of outside shareholders.
paragraphs.translation: 建房互助会协会介绍，这类机构由借款者与储蓄者组成的成员所有，而非由一群独立的外部股东所有。

paragraphs.text: The association speaks for that sector and advocates its interests in discussion with government and regulators.
paragraphs.translation: 协会代表该行业，在与政府和监管者讨论时倡导其利益。

paragraphs.text: Its role is that of an industry voice, while regulation and complaint resolution are separate functions.
paragraphs.translation: 它承担行业发声角色，而监管与投诉处理是另外的职能。

paragraphs.text: The sustainability of an income stream depends on how it is produced and maintained.
paragraphs.translation: 收入流的可维持性，取决于它怎样产生和维持。

paragraphs.text: Distributing more than an activity can continue to support would mean drawing on it unsustainably.
paragraphs.translation: 分配超出活动能够持续支持的金额，就意味着以无法维持的方式从中提取资源。

title: What Soil Asks of the Gardener

paragraphs.text: A garden begins below the flowers, in the spaces between particles of earth.
paragraphs.translation: 花园的起点在花朵之下，在土壤颗粒之间的空隙里。

paragraphs.text: Water and air must both reach the roots, although they compete for those spaces.
paragraphs.translation: 水和空气都必须到达根部，尽管它们要占据同一些空隙。

paragraphs.text: The RHS distinguishes soils partly by particle size, with clay finer than silt and sand.
paragraphs.translation: 英国皇家园艺学会部分依据颗粒大小区分土壤，黏土颗粒比粉土和砂粒更细。

paragraphs.text: Fine clay is moisture-retentive, whereas a sandy bed can lose water quickly.
paragraphs.translation: 细黏土能保持水分，而砂质种植畦可能很快失水。

paragraphs.text: The retentiveness of a soil therefore matters as much as how easily a spade enters it.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，土壤的保水能力与铲子是否容易插入同样重要。

paragraphs.text: A loose handful and a sticky lump offer different problems to the cultivator.
paragraphs.translation: 对于耕种者而言，一把松散的土与一块黏土带来的是不同问题。

paragraphs.text: To cultivate a plot is to prepare and use its ground for growing plants.
paragraphs.translation: 耕作一块地，就是整理并利用那里的土壤种植植物。

paragraphs.text: To cultivate the surface more narrowly means to loosen it, often with a fork or a cultivator.
paragraphs.translation: 更具体地说，对表层进行中耕就是松土，常会用到叉子或耕耘工具。

paragraphs.text: That operation has a purpose; repeated disturbance is not itself proof of good cultivation.
paragraphs.translation: 这种操作应有目的；反复扰动本身并不能证明栽培得法。

paragraphs.text: Wet clay can become compacted under feet and machinery, while bare silt can be carried away.
paragraphs.translation: 湿黏土会在踩踏和机械作用下板结，裸露的粉土则可能流失。

paragraphs.text: The RHS describes adding organic matter as a way to improve the structure of several soil types.
paragraphs.translation: 皇家园艺学会介绍，加入有机质可以改善多种土壤的结构。

paragraphs.text: In clay it helps produce workable crumbs, while in sand it improves the holding of water and nutrients.
paragraphs.translation: 在黏土中，它有助于形成便于耕作的团粒；在砂土中，它改善保水和保肥能力。

paragraphs.text: Cultivable land is land capable of supporting cultivation under the relevant conditions.
paragraphs.translation: 可耕地是指在相关条件下能够用于耕作的土地。

paragraphs.text: Calling a patch cultivatable does not specify which crop will thrive there.
paragraphs.translation: 说一块地可以耕作，并未说明哪一种作物能在那里茁壮生长。

paragraphs.text: A cultivated variety has a history of being grown and developed by people.
paragraphs.translation: 栽培品种有着由人种植和培育的历史。

paragraphs.text: To cultivate strawberries successfully, for example, requires attention to the plant as well as to the ground.
paragraphs.translation: 例如，要成功栽培草莓，除了土壤之外，还须关注植物本身。

paragraphs.text: A vigorous plant may be a good yielder, but its yield still depends on the season and its growing conditions.
paragraphs.translation: 一株长势旺盛的植物可能很丰产，但其产量仍取决于季节和生长条件。

paragraphs.text: A bed that yields little fruit may nevertheless reveal a great deal about light, drainage and care.
paragraphs.translation: 一块结果很少的种植畦，仍可能让人了解到许多有关光照、排水和养护的知识。

paragraphs.text: Water conservation connects these small decisions to a larger resource.
paragraphs.translation: 节约用水把这些细小决定与更大的资源问题联系起来。

paragraphs.text: Choosing plants suited to the soil helps conserve water rather than requiring the ground to imitate another climate.
paragraphs.translation: 选择适合当地土壤的植物有助于节水，而不必让土地模拟另一种气候。

paragraphs.text: Gardening sustainably includes keeping useful soil in place and avoiding needless inputs.
paragraphs.translation: 以可持续方式园艺，包括留住有用的土壤并避免不必要的投入。

paragraphs.text: Its sustainability depends on preserving the soil and water resources needed for future seasons.
paragraphs.translation: 它的生态可持续性，取决于能否保存未来各季所需的土壤与水资源。

paragraphs.text: The aim is a happy medium between constant interference and complete neglect.
paragraphs.translation: 目标是在不断干预与完全疏于照料之间找到恰当的平衡。

paragraphs.text: Such a medium is a practical balance, not a universal quantity of water or compost.
paragraphs.translation: 这种中间状态是实际的平衡，并非一套普适的浇水或施肥数量。

title: A Strawberry Season Kept in Glass

paragraphs.text: Fresh fruit creates a problem of timing: the crop arrives faster than a household can eat it.
paragraphs.translation: 鲜果带来一个时间问题：收获到来的速度，可能比一家人吃掉它的速度更快。

paragraphs.text: To conserve fruit in sugar is one answer with a long culinary history.
paragraphs.translation: 用糖保存水果，是一种有着悠久烹饪历史的答案。

paragraphs.text: Conserves can preserve recognizable pieces, giving the eater something more substantial than a smooth sweet paste.
paragraphs.translation: 糖渍水果可以保留可辨认的果块，吃起来比均匀的甜糊更有实在的果肉感。

paragraphs.text: A strawberry conserve, in the British jam sense, is valued for its generous fruit content.
paragraphs.translation: 英式果酱意义上的草莓conserve，以较高的果实含量受到重视。

paragraphs.text: The American National Center for Home Food Preservation calls its related preparation strawberry preserves.
paragraphs.translation: 美国国家家庭食品保存中心，把其相关制品称为strawberry preserves。

paragraphs.text: Its published method begins by placing prepared fruit and sugar in alternate layers.
paragraphs.translation: 其公布的方法，先把处理好的水果与糖一层隔一层地放置。

paragraphs.text: The fruit and sugar thus enter the vessel alternately, before a resting period allows the mixture to develop.
paragraphs.translation: 于是，水果与糖交替进入容器，随后静置，使混合物逐渐形成。

paragraphs.text: The later heating thickens the syrup while gentle stirring helps keep the fruit from sticking.
paragraphs.translation: 之后的加热使糖浆变稠，轻轻搅拌则有助于防止水果黏底。

paragraphs.text: A pot's capacity matters because a bubbling mixture needs room as well as an accurate quantity of ingredients.
paragraphs.translation: 锅的容量很重要，因为沸腾的混合物不仅需要准确的配料量，也需要空间。

paragraphs.text: The published yield is approximately four half-pint jars.
paragraphs.translation: 所列制成量约为四个半品脱罐。

paragraphs.text: That is a measure of finished preserves, distinct from the volume of freshly picked berries.
paragraphs.translation: 这是成品的量，与刚采下的浆果体积不同。

paragraphs.text: Sugar contributes more than sweetness to this kind of preservation.
paragraphs.translation: 在这种保存方式中，糖的作用不只是提供甜味。

paragraphs.text: The Center's accompanying explanation says that replacing it with a non-sugar sweetener can change the preservation requirements of syrupy fruit products.
paragraphs.translation: 该中心的附带说明指出，用非糖甜味剂替代糖，可能改变糖浆水果制品的保存要求。

paragraphs.text: A flavour enhancer can alter what the tongue notices without reproducing sugar's other functions.
paragraphs.translation: 增味剂可以改变舌头感受到的味道，却未必复制糖的其他作用。

paragraphs.text: The full tested method includes processing instructions that vary with elevation.
paragraphs.translation: 完整的经检验方法包含随海拔变化的加工说明。

paragraphs.text: A discussion of taste therefore cannot substitute for the published preparation and processing directions.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，关于口味的讨论不能代替所公布的制作与加工指引。

paragraphs.text: The anticipation of opening a jar later is part of the pleasure of making it.
paragraphs.translation: 期待日后打开一罐，也是制作的乐趣之一。

paragraphs.text: A household may conserve part of a harvest in anticipation of winter meals.
paragraphs.translation: 一家人可以预先为冬日餐食打算，把一部分收成保存下来。

paragraphs.text: A meal can sustain the body and also recall the labour that made it possible.
paragraphs.translation: 一顿饭既能滋养身体，也能唤起人们对成就这顿饭的劳动的记忆。

paragraphs.text: A hungry diner could shift a whole jar at once, although the preserved harvest was meant to last.
paragraphs.translation: 饥饿的食客可能一口气就吃掉整罐，尽管保存下来的收成本应留着慢慢享用。

title: Why Some Beer Keeps Changing in Its Container

paragraphs.text: CAMRA's guide describes secondary fermentation in which live yeast continues to act on sugars after beer has entered a container.
paragraphs.translation: CAMRA的指南介绍了二次发酵：啤酒装入容器后，活酵母继续作用于糖。

paragraphs.text: The yeast can evolve carbon dioxide, changing how the beer feels as well as how it matures.
paragraphs.translation: 酵母可以放出二氧化碳，既改变啤酒的口感，也影响其熟成。

paragraphs.text: This evolution of gas differs from simply adding gas under pressure.
paragraphs.translation: 这种气体的释放，与直接以压力加入气体不同。

paragraphs.text: When suspended yeast and other particles settle, sediment collects below the clearer liquid.
paragraphs.translation: 悬浮的酵母及其他颗粒沉降时，沉渣便聚集在较清澈的液体下方。

paragraphs.text: A sedimented drink has material at the bottom that can be disturbed by movement.
paragraphs.translation: 有沉淀的饮料，其底部物质可能因移动而重新扰动。

paragraphs.text: Pouring and transport can therefore change what appears in a glass without changing the original ingredients.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，倾倒与运输可能改变杯中所见，而原先的配料并没有改变。

paragraphs.text: Judging the drink requires someone able to discriminate, noticing style and condition rather than treating every visible particle as the same phenomenon.
paragraphs.translation: 判断这种饮料，需要有鉴别力的人注意风格与状态，而不是把每一种可见颗粒都当成同一种现象。

paragraphs.text: An indiscriminative judgement would call all cloudiness a fault, regardless of what kind of beer was intended.
paragraphs.translation: 不加分辨的判断，会不顾所要制作的啤酒类型，把一切浑浊都称为缺陷。

paragraphs.text: A thoughtful taster makes a discrimination between an intended characteristic and an unwanted change.
paragraphs.translation: 善于思考的品尝者，会在预期特征与不希望出现的变化之间作出区分。

paragraphs.text: Hand pumps and casks can belong to sedimented traditions, built up through repeated work rather than invented afresh at each visit.
paragraphs.translation: 手压泵与酒桶可以属于长期积淀的传统，这些传统由反复劳动形成，而不是每次到访时重新发明。

paragraphs.text: CAMRA's account notes that modern methods blur older divisions between cask and keg.
paragraphs.translation: CAMRA的介绍指出，现代方法使旧有的木桶式与密闭酒桶式分类界限变得模糊。

title: A Musical Phrase Has More Than One Kind of Time

paragraphs.text: On an acoustic piano, the damper pedal lifts the dampers so that strings can keep vibrating.
paragraphs.translation: 在声学钢琴上，制音踏板抬起制音器，使琴弦能继续振动。

paragraphs.text: It allows a player to sustain a note across a movement of the hand.
paragraphs.translation: 它使演奏者能够在手移动时延续一个音。

paragraphs.text: The resulting sustain can join distant notes or let several tones overlap.
paragraphs.translation: 由此产生的延音，可以连接相距较远的音，也可以让多个音彼此重叠。

paragraphs.text: Yamaha's guide describes both connected pedalling and deliberately overlapping sound.
paragraphs.translation: 雅马哈的指南既介绍了连接式踏板运用，也介绍了有意让声音重叠的做法。

paragraphs.text: Refreshing the pedal can clear one harmony before the next fills the space.
paragraphs.translation: 重新抬落踏板，可以在下一个和声充满空间之前，清理前一个和声。

paragraphs.text: Harmony has its own timing, which need not coincide exactly with a melody's arrival.
paragraphs.translation: 和声有自己的时间安排，它未必与旋律中某个音的到来完全一致。

paragraphs.text: An anticipation brings in a note belonging to the coming harmony before that harmony arrives.
paragraphs.translation: 先现音使属于下一个和声的音，在那个和声到来之前先出现。

paragraphs.text: Open Music Theory explains that the same note then belongs to the new chord when the harmony changes.
paragraphs.translation: 《开放音乐理论》解释说，和声改变之后，同一个音便成为新和弦中的音。

paragraphs.text: A suspension works differently: a note from the preceding harmony remains while the harmony changes, then resolves.
paragraphs.translation: 延留音以不同方式起作用：前一个和声中的音，在和声改变时仍然留住，随后才解决。

paragraphs.text: In rhythmic diminution, a melody returns in shorter note values, perhaps with every value halved.
paragraphs.translation: 在节奏减值中，一段旋律以更短的音符时值重现，例如每个时值都减半。

paragraphs.text: The proportions remain intelligible even as the material occupies less time.
paragraphs.translation: 即使材料占用的时间缩短，各部分的比例仍然能够被理解。

paragraphs.text: This is different from holding the same written durations and merely changing tempo.
paragraphs.translation: 这与保留原有谱面时值、只是改变速度有所不同。

paragraphs.text: In a waltz, dancers can reverse, turning in the opposite rotational direction while the musical pulse continues.
paragraphs.translation: 跳华尔兹时，舞者可以反向旋转，而音乐的节拍仍在继续。

paragraphs.text: The ISTD's 2018 teaching syllabus includes both Natural Turn and Reverse Turn and asks teachers to connect figures with timing, alignment and footwork.
paragraphs.translation: 帝国舞蹈教师协会（ISTD）2018年的教学纲要列有右转步与左转步，并要求教师将舞步与节奏、方位和步法联系起来。

paragraphs.text: Students at a conservatory study how such relationships work while developing the physical skill to realize them.
paragraphs.translation: 音乐学院的学生，一边研究这些关系如何起作用，一边发展实现它们所需的身体技能。

paragraphs.text: The same work belongs in a conservatoire, the term familiar in many European institutions.
paragraphs.translation: 同样的学习也属于conservatoire的教学内容，这个词在许多欧洲院校中很常见。

paragraphs.text: A learner may eagerly anticipate the day when a difficult phrase finally feels free.
paragraphs.translation: 学习者可能热切期待，艰难的乐句终于变得自如的那一天。

paragraphs.text: Anticipatory listening helps the player prepare a hand movement before the next note is needed.
paragraphs.translation: 预先听见后续声音的倾听方式，有助于演奏者在下一个音需要出现前准备手的动作。

paragraphs.text: This anticipative attention is active: it reaches towards a sound that has not yet happened.
paragraphs.translation: 这种预期性的注意是主动的：它朝向一个尚未发生的声音。

paragraphs.text: Practice done persistently can make preparation less visible while leaving it no less essential.
paragraphs.translation: 持续坚持的练习，能够使准备动作不那么显眼，却不会降低其必要性。

paragraphs.text: A trained ear becomes a discriminator of small differences in timing, helping a player hear why two apparently similar phrases feel unlike.
paragraphs.translation: 经过训练的耳朵成为细微时值差异的辨别者，帮助演奏者听出两段看似相似的乐句为何感受不同。

title: A Clutch Must Know When to Slip

paragraphs.text: A friction clutch connects rotating shafts through surfaces pressed together.
paragraphs.translation: 摩擦离合器通过相互压紧的表面连接转轴。

paragraphs.text: A friction disc provides one of those contact surfaces.
paragraphs.translation: 摩擦片提供其中的一个接触面。

paragraphs.text: MathWorks describes three states: separated, touching while slipping, and locked together.
paragraphs.translation: MathWorks介绍了三种状态：分离、接触但滑动，以及锁定在一起。

paragraphs.text: During slipping, friction between the surfaces tends to reduce their relative speed.
paragraphs.translation: 滑动期间，接触面之间的摩擦力倾向于降低它们的相对速度。

paragraphs.text: Repeated friction can also wear a contacting surface.
paragraphs.translation: 反复擦动也可能磨损接触面。

paragraphs.text: Frictional heating is a consequence of energy being dissipated rather than all becoming useful motion.
paragraphs.translation: 摩擦发热，是能量耗散而没有全部转化为有用运动的结果。

paragraphs.text: When the surfaces lock, the shafts rotate together even though static friction can still transmit torque.
paragraphs.translation: 接触面锁定时，两根轴共同旋转，而静摩擦仍能传递转矩。

paragraphs.text: Thus the absence of sliding does not make the contact frictionless.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，没有滑动并不意味着接触处没有摩擦。

paragraphs.text: Its capacity to transmit torque depends on the surfaces and the force pressing them together.
paragraphs.translation: 它传递转矩的能力，取决于接触面及将它们压在一起的力。

paragraphs.text: The mounting structure must also sustain the weight of the assembly while keeping the rotating parts aligned.
paragraphs.translation: 安装支撑结构还必须承受整个组件的重量，同时让各旋转部件保持对准。

paragraphs.text: A yielding component can bend under that load; whether this helps or harms the mechanism depends on its purpose.
paragraphs.translation: 可变形的部件能在该负荷下弯曲；这对机构有利还是有害，取决于它的用途。

paragraphs.text: Some yieldingness is useful in a spring, while a part intended to stay rigid may fail if it yields too far.
paragraphs.translation: 弹簧具有一定柔顺性是有用的；而本应保持刚性的部件若让变形发展过大，则可能失效。

paragraphs.text: Retainers keep other components in their intended positions, even while nearby parts move.
paragraphs.translation: 固定件使其他部件保持在预定位置，即使附近的部件正在运动。

paragraphs.text: A retaining clip, for example, can retain a part on a shaft.
paragraphs.translation: 例如，固定夹可以把部件保持在轴上。

paragraphs.text: A vehicle's transmission organizes the relationship between engine rotation and wheel rotation.
paragraphs.translation: 车辆的传动装置组织发动机转动与车轮转动之间的关系。

paragraphs.text: In a manual vehicle, the driver uses a shifter to select a gear.
paragraphs.translation: 在手动档车辆中，驾驶员用换档装置选择档位。

paragraphs.text: Moving the shift changes the position of a lever; inside the transmission, the shift must translate that movement into the engagement of a different gear.
paragraphs.translation: 移动变速杆，改变的是一根杆的位置；在传动装置内部，换档机构必须把这一移动转化为另一档齿轮的接合。

paragraphs.text: To shift up is to select a higher gear; to shift down is to select a lower one.
paragraphs.translation: 升档是选择更高的档位；降档是选择更低的档位。

paragraphs.text: The driver shifts gears as the demands on the engine and wheels change.
paragraphs.translation: 发动机与车轮所受要求改变时，驾驶员便换档。

paragraphs.text: The driver does not have to reverse the engine to make the vehicle travel backwards.
paragraphs.translation: 让车辆向后行驶，并不要求驾驶员使发动机反向运转。

paragraphs.text: A reverse gear changes the direction of the driven output instead.
paragraphs.translation: 倒档改变的是被驱动输出端的方向。

paragraphs.text: Selecting reverse enables the vehicle to reverse, with the wheels carrying it backwards.
paragraphs.translation: 挂入倒档后，车辆便能倒车，由车轮带着它向后移动。

paragraphs.text: The reversing arrangement acts as a reverser within the larger transmission system.
paragraphs.translation: 换向机构在更大的传动系统中起着反向器的作用。

title: A Folded Shield Opens a View into the Past

paragraphs.text: The James Webb Space Telescope had to become larger after leaving Earth.
paragraphs.translation: 詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜必须在离开地球后变得更大。

paragraphs.text: Its sunshield was folded for launch, then deployed remotely in a sequence completed on 4 January 2022.
paragraphs.translation: 它的遮阳板在发射时折叠，随后通过遥控逐步展开，并于2022年1月4日完成这一过程。

paragraphs.text: The mechanisms evolved the folded layers, opening them out before the final tensioning.
paragraphs.translation: 机构将折叠的各层展开，在最后张紧之前把它们打开。

paragraphs.text: This physical evolution gave the shield its broad working shape.
paragraphs.translation: 这种实际的展开，使遮阳板形成了宽阔的工作形态。

paragraphs.text: Supports extended, the telescope and instruments gained separation from the shield, and the membranes were drawn into position.
paragraphs.translation: 支架伸出，望远镜与仪器同遮阳板拉开距离，薄膜被拉到位。

paragraphs.text: The result was a five-layer barrier between delicate observations and unwanted heat.
paragraphs.translation: 结果是一道五层屏障，将精细观测与不需要的热量隔开。

paragraphs.text: A warm telescope would itself produce infrared radiation that could obscure the faint signals being sought.
paragraphs.translation: 温热的望远镜自身会产生红外辐射，可能掩盖所要寻找的微弱信号。

paragraphs.text: Some light that began its journey in an early galaxy reaches us at wavelengths longer than those at which it was emitted.
paragraphs.translation: 某些在早期星系开始旅程的光，到达我们时的波长，比发射时更长。

paragraphs.text: As the universe expands, the wavelength of travelling light can be stretched.
paragraphs.translation: 随着宇宙膨胀，传播中的光的波长可以被拉长。

paragraphs.text: Astronomers identify a shift by comparing recognizable spectral features with their reference positions.
paragraphs.translation: 天文学家通过把可辨认的光谱特征与其参考位置比较，识别出位移。

paragraphs.text: A red shift is a displacement towards longer wavelengths, which may carry visible light into the infrared.
paragraphs.translation: 红移是向更长波长的偏移，它可能把可见光移入红外波段。

paragraphs.text: The name describes a direction along the spectrum rather than a promise that every object will look red to the eye.
paragraphs.translation: 这个名称描述的是沿光谱的方向，并不表示每个物体在肉眼看来都会是红色。

paragraphs.text: The journey of the light also takes time, so distant observations show galaxies at earlier stages of their history.
paragraphs.translation: 光的旅程也需要时间，因此，对远方的观测呈现的是星系历史上较早的阶段。

paragraphs.text: Infrared instruments widen the range of that history available for study.
paragraphs.translation: 红外仪器扩大了能够研究的那段历史范围。

paragraphs.text: Anticipation of the thermal conditions shaped the engineering long before the shield was opened.
paragraphs.translation: 对热条件的预先考虑，在遮阳板打开之前很久就影响了工程设计。

title: The Work Behind a Court-Appointed Conservator

paragraphs.text: Utah's courts explain that a conservator receives authority through an appointment order and the accompanying letters.
paragraphs.translation: 犹他州法院解释，财产监护人的权限来自任命命令及相应的证明文件。

paragraphs.text: The order determines whether that authority is limited or full.
paragraphs.translation: 命令决定这种权限是有限的还是完整的。

paragraphs.text: Legal capacity is consequently a specific question about a person and an act, rather than a single informal judgement that someone is generally incapable.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，法律行为能力是有关某个人及某种行为的具体问题，而不是一句笼统认定某人总体上没有能力的非正式评语。

paragraphs.text: The practical work may include accounts, property, payments and reports to the court.
paragraphs.translation: 实际工作可能包括账目、财产、付款及向法院提交报告。

paragraphs.text: The Utah guidance allows a conservator to seek advice and use professional assistance.
paragraphs.translation: 犹他州的指引允许财产监护人寻求建议并使用专业协助。

paragraphs.text: If legal work is needed, the arrangement may require money to retain a lawyer for future services.
paragraphs.translation: 如需法律工作，相关安排可能需要预付费用聘请律师，以便日后获得服务。

paragraphs.text: A retainer secures that availability under the terms of the professional agreement.
paragraphs.translation: 预付服务费按照专业协议的条款，确保需要时能够获得服务。

paragraphs.text: Hiring an agent for particular work does not transfer the court appointment itself.
paragraphs.translation: 聘请代理人办理特定工作，并不会转移法院任命的职位本身。

paragraphs.text: The conservator still has to understand what has been delegated and remain responsible for it.
paragraphs.translation: 财产监护人仍须了解委托了哪些工作，并继续为其负责。

paragraphs.text: Nor can a person simply transmit the office to someone else as if handing over an ordinary object.
paragraphs.translation: 受任者也不能像交出普通物品一样，把职位直接转交给别人。

paragraphs.text: Responsibility survives that attempted transmittal because it derives from the court's order.
paragraphs.translation: 这种试图移交并不会消除责任，因为责任源于法院的命令。

paragraphs.text: The conservator cannot shift responsibility onto an adviser simply by asking for help.
paragraphs.translation: 财产监护人不能仅仅因为请人帮忙，就把责任推到顾问身上。

paragraphs.text: To shift off the duty onto someone else would leave precisely the gap in care that the appointment is meant to address.
paragraphs.translation: 把这项职责推给别人，恰好会留下设立该任命原本要解决的照管空缺。

paragraphs.text: The job can require difficult conversations about needs, resources and different wishes.
paragraphs.translation: 这项工作可能要求人们就需求、资源与不同愿望开展艰难的谈话。

paragraphs.text: A family intervention intended to persuade someone to seek help is a different kind of activity from a court appointment.
paragraphs.translation: 家人为劝说某人寻求帮助而共同进行的劝助行动，与法院任命是不同性质的事情。

paragraphs.text: In a dispute, mediation may offer intervention aimed at helping the parties reach a settlement.
paragraphs.translation: 发生争执时，调解可以提供旨在帮助各方达成和解的居间介入。

paragraphs.text: Parties may compromise a dispute, in the formal legal sense of settling it by agreement.
paragraphs.translation: 当事人可以通过协议和解争端，这是compromise的一种正式法律用法。

paragraphs.text: Neither conversation nor delegation removes the need to attend to the actual person whose affairs are being managed.
paragraphs.translation: 无论谈话还是委托，都不会消除关注那个事务被管理者本人的必要。

title: Two Clubs Can Ask a Question

paragraphs.text: A bridge player speaks through an auction in which every legal call is public.
paragraphs.translation: 桥牌牌手通过叫牌交流，而每一个合法叫品都是公开的。

paragraphs.text: The challenge is to describe two concealed hands well enough for a partnership to choose a contract.
paragraphs.translation: 挑战在于，搭档须把两手隐藏的牌描述得足够清楚，以便选择定约。

paragraphs.text: Some bids describe a suit directly, while others carry an agreed question.
paragraphs.translation: 一些叫品直接描述某一花色，另一些则承载事先约定的问题。

paragraphs.text: The Welsh Bridge Union's teaching scheme introduces Stayman as a convention used after a one-no-trump opening.
paragraphs.translation: 威尔士桥牌联盟的教学方案，把Stayman介绍为一无将开叫后使用的一种叫牌约定。

paragraphs.text: In the version taught there, two clubs asks whether opener has a four-card major.
paragraphs.translation: 在其中教授的版本中，二梅花询问开叫者是否持有四张高花。

paragraphs.text: The named suit therefore does not itself promise a holding in clubs.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，叫出的花色本身，并不保证手里有相应的梅花牌。

paragraphs.text: The replies distinguish no four-card major, four hearts, and four spades without four hearts.
paragraphs.translation: 回答区分没有四张高花、有四张红心，以及有四张黑桃但没有四张红心的情况。

paragraphs.text: This gives the partnership a way to look for a four-four fit in hearts or spades.
paragraphs.translation: 这让搭档能够寻找红心或黑桃的四四配合。

paragraphs.text: A shift to a new suit during bidding can then disclose further information or seek a different destination.
paragraphs.translation: 随后，在叫牌中改叫新花色，可以披露更多信息，或寻找另一种定约方向。

paragraphs.text: Its meaning depends on what has already been said and on the system the pair is using.
paragraphs.translation: 其意义取决于此前叫过什么，以及搭档所采用的体系。

paragraphs.text: The teaching notes emphasize being prepared for any reply to the question.
paragraphs.translation: 教学笔记强调，提出问题时须为任何可能回答做好准备。

paragraphs.text: Asking about a major may lead to a reply that does not match responder's own hand.
paragraphs.translation: 询问高花，可能得到与应叫者自己手牌不相配的回答。

paragraphs.text: The next bid must still represent the strength and distribution actually held.
paragraphs.translation: 下一个叫品仍必须表达实际持有的牌力与牌型。

paragraphs.text: Once play begins, a defender's shift to another suit changes the immediate problem in a different way.
paragraphs.translation: 开始打牌后，防守者改出另一花色，会以另一种方式改变眼前的问题。

paragraphs.text: Cards already played become information that both sides can use.
paragraphs.translation: 已经打出的牌，变成双方都可以使用的信息。

paragraphs.text: Bridge thus makes communication part of the game itself: a partnership must turn limited public signals into coordinated action.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，桥牌把交流变成游戏本身的一部分：搭档必须把有限的公开信号，转化为协调一致的行动。
